title: Armor of Elohim
subtitle: 7 days of spiritual warfare prayer from Ephesians 6
note: WEB, divine name rendered YHWH, Elohim, and Adonai

days.title: Day 1
days.subtitle: The Belt of Truth
days.lede: Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist. (Ephesians 6:14)
days.note: WEB, divine name rendered YHWH, Elohim, and Adonai
days.shareText:
Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist.
Ephesians 6:14

Every other piece hangs from the belt. Buckle on His truth first.

https://app.kingdom-life-ministry.com
days.step: Write down one lie you have been believing. Next to it, write one verse that answers it. Read that verse out loud this morning and again tonight.

blocks.v: Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist,
Righteousness will be the belt of his waist, and faithfulness the belt of his waist.

Isaiah saw this belt on the Messiah before Paul ever wrote about it. When you buckle on truth, you are wearing what Yahshua wears. On the first Passover, Israel ate with their belts fastened, ready to move the moment YHWH said go (Exodus 12:11).

Every other piece hangs from the belt. If truth is loose, everything slides. The enemy rarely brings a new lie. He repeats old ones until they feel true: you are too far gone, you can never forgive that, that is just who you are.
Truth is not how you feel about yourself today. It is what YHWH has already said. You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free (John 8:32).
Yahshua, You are the way, the truth, and the life. I come to You first.
I buckle Your truth around me today. Your word is truth, and I choose it over my feelings, my past, and what anyone else has said about me.
In Your name I renounce every lie I have believed about who I am, about who You are, and about the people I need to forgive.
Show me the lie I keep repeating. Pull it out by the root and put Your word in its place.
Make me firm and steady, and ready to move when You say go. Amen.
The soldier Paul saw: the Roman military belt marked a man as a soldier on duty. Before running or fighting, men tucked their long tunics into the belt so nothing tangled their legs.

The word behind it: the Hebrew word for truth is emet, from a root meaning firm and reliable. The word for faithfulness in Isaiah 11:5, emunah, comes from the same root. In Scripture, truth is something you can put your full weight on.
Write down one lie you have been believing. Next to it, write one verse that answers it. Read that verse out loud this morning and again tonight.

days.title: Day 2
days.subtitle: The Breastplate of Righteousness
days.lede: ...having put on the breastplate of righteousness. (Ephesians 6:14)
days.note: WEB, divine name rendered YHWH, Elohim, and Adonai
days.shareText:
...having put on the breastplate of righteousness.
Ephesians 6:14

We are not building our own righteousness. We are putting on His.

https://app.kingdom-life-ministry.com
days.step: Ask Yahshua to show you one small compromise you have been excusing. Confess it, and take one practical step today to close that crack.

blocks.v: and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,
He put on righteousness as a breastplate, and a helmet of salvation on his head;

When YHWH saw that no one could rescue His people, He dressed for battle Himself. The breastplate Paul tells us to put on is the one He wore. We are not building our own righteousness. We are putting on His.

Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life (Proverbs 4:23). The enemy works through small cracks: a compromise excused, a sin hidden, a grudge kept. Guilt and shame pour in through those cracks until you feel too dirty to stand.
Unforgiveness is one of the widest cracks there is. Yahshua tied our forgiveness to our forgiving others (Matthew 6:14-15). Pride holds the grudge in place. Humility lets it go.
Yahshua, You are my righteousness. I cannot cover my own heart, so I put on what You won for me.
I bring every hidden sin into the light. You are faithful and righteous to forgive when I confess (1 John 1:9).
Show me the small compromises I have excused, and give me the strength to close every crack.
I choose to forgive the people who hurt me. I name them before You now, I release them, and I lay down my pride.
In Your name I reject every accusation of guilt and shame that Your blood has already answered.
Guard my heart today, and teach me to walk in Your instructions. Amen.
The soldier Paul saw: Roman soldiers wore iron body armor, either mail made of linked rings or overlapping iron bands. It covered the chest and back, where one blow could end a life.

The word behind it: the Hebrew word for righteousness is tsedaqah, what is right and straight by YHWH's measure. The high priest also wore a breastpiece, and he carried the names of the tribes of Israel over his heart when he went in before YHWH (Exodus 28:29).
Ask Yahshua to show you one small compromise you have been excusing. Confess it, and take one practical step today to close that crack.

days.title: Day 3
days.subtitle: The Shoes of Peace
days.lede: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace. (Isaiah 52:7)
days.note: WEB, divine name rendered YHWH, Elohim, and Adonai
days.shareText:
How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace.
Isaiah 52:7

You do not fight for peace with Elohim. You fight from it.

https://app.kingdom-life-ministry.com
days.step: Ask Yahshua to bring one person to mind that you need to make peace with. Take one step today: a prayer of release, a text, or a call.

blocks.v: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace;
How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace, who brings good news of good, who publishes salvation, who says to Zion, 'Your Elohim reigns!'
Yahshua Himself is our peace. He made the two into one and broke down the wall between them (Ephesians 2:14). And the Elohim of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet (Romans 16:20).
Peace is not the absence of battle. It is the ground you stand on in the middle of one. You do not fight for peace with Elohim. You fight from it, because Yahshua already made it (Romans 5:1).
These shoes point outward too. As much as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone (Romans 12:18). It is hard to carry good news of peace to someone you refuse to release.
Yahshua, You are my peace. Plant my feet on the ground You already won.
I refuse to be moved by fear, chaos, or bad news today. Let Your peace guard my heart and my thoughts.
Show me anyone I need to make peace with, and give me the humility to take the first step.
Make me ready to carry Your good news wherever You send me.
In Your name I stand on Your promise that the enemy will be crushed under my feet. Amen.

The soldier Paul saw: Roman soldiers wore heavy sandal boots called caligae, with iron hobnails in the soles that gripped rough ground. In close fighting, the man who lost his footing was the man in danger.

The word behind it: Paul's word for preparation, hetoimasia, means readiness. The Greek Old Testament uses the same word for the foundation of His throne (Psalm 89:14). Ready to move, and planted on solid ground. The Hebrew word shalom means whole, everything in its right place.
Ask Yahshua to bring one person to mind that you need to make peace with. Take one step today: a prayer of release, a text, or a call.

days.title: Day 4
days.subtitle: The Shield of Faith
days.lede: I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward. (Genesis 15:1)
days.note: WEB, divine name rendered YHWH, Elohim, and Adonai
days.shareText:
I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward.
Genesis 15:1

His faithfulness is the shield. Your faith is the hand that lifts it.

https://app.kingdom-life-ministry.com
days.step: Write down three times YHWH was faithful to you. Share one of them with someone today.

blocks.v: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.
Don't be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward.
Psalm 91:4 says His faithfulness is your shield. The shield is not your faith as a feeling. The shield is His faithfulness, and your faith is the hand that lifts it.

Fiery darts come fast and without warning: a sudden doubt, a wave of fear, an accusation, a temptation. You do not have to argue with every one. Lift the shield and set what YHWH has said and done between you and the dart.

Feed your faith with the word (Romans 10:17). Rehearse His faithfulness in your own story (Revelation 12:11). And do not fight alone. A lone shield covers one person. Locked shields cover a whole unit.
Yahshua, You are my shield. Your faithfulness has never failed me.
I lift my faith against every fiery dart aimed at me today: doubt, fear, accusation, and temptation.
In Your name I quench every one of them. They will not take root in me.
Remind me of every time You came through, and let those memories strengthen my grip.
Surround me with faithful brothers and sisters, and help me cover them too. Amen.

The soldier Paul saw: Paul's word for shield, thureos, is related to the Greek word for door. The Roman scutum was large and curved, and the historian Polybius described it as layered wood covered with canvas and calfskin. Soldiers could lock shields together in a formation called the testudo, the tortoise.

The word behind it: the Greek word for faith, pistis, means both trust and faithfulness. The righteous will live by his faith (Habakkuk 2:4). Faith is not a mood. It is steady trust that keeps holding on.
Write down three times YHWH was faithful to you. Share one of them with someone today.

days.title: Day 5
days.subtitle: The Helmet of Salvation
days.lede: And take the helmet of salvation. (Ephesians 6:17)
days.note: WEB, divine name rendered YHWH, Elohim, and Adonai
days.shareText:
And take the helmet of salvation.
Ephesians 6:17

Cover your mind with what His name means: salvation.

https://app.kingdom-life-ministry.com
days.step: Catch one thought that keeps coming back. Write it down, find a verse that answers it, and replace the thought with that verse every time it returns.

blocks.v: And take the helmet of salvation,
He put on righteousness as a breastplate, and a helmet of salvation on his head;
The Hebrew word for salvation there is yeshuah: rescue, deliverance, victory. The name Yahshua is built on the same root. When you put on this helmet, you cover your mind with what His name means.
The mind is where many battles are won or lost. The enemy whispers: you are still guilty, nothing will ever change, Elohim is done with you. Those thoughts aim straight at the head.

The helmet answers them. There is no condemnation for those who are in Messiah Yahshua (Romans 8:1). Take every thought captive (2 Corinthians 10:5). If a thought does not line up with the word, it does not stay.
Yahshua, Your name means salvation, and You are my salvation. Cover my mind today.
In Your name I reject every thought of condemnation, hopelessness, and fear that did not come from You.
I take every thought captive to Your obedience. Renew my mind with Your word.
I have been rescued, I am being delivered, and I will be raised when You return.
Let that hope guard my thoughts all day. Amen.

The soldier Paul saw: the Roman helmet, the galea, was bronze or iron, with hinged cheek pieces and a guard at the back of the neck. A soldier could survive many wounds, but a blow to the head was often the end.

The word behind it: Paul calls the helmet the hope of salvation in 1 Thessalonians 5:8, right after describing the day Yahshua returns at the trumpet (1 Thessalonians 4:16-17). Yeshuah is also the word Moses used at the Red Sea: stand still and see the salvation of YHWH (Exodus 14:13).
Catch one thought that keeps coming back. Write it down, find a verse that answers it, and replace the thought with that verse every time it returns.

days.title: Day 6
days.subtitle: The Sword of the Spirit
days.lede: Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of Elohim's mouth. (Matthew 4:4)
days.note: WEB, divine name rendered YHWH, Elohim, and Adonai
days.shareText:
Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of Elohim's mouth.
Matthew 4:4

The sword works when it is in your mouth.

https://app.kingdom-life-ministry.com
days.step: Pick the biggest battle you are facing. Find one verse that speaks to it, memorize it, and say it out loud every time that battle shows up.

blocks.v: and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of Elohim;
It is written, 'Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of Elohim's mouth.'
Every time the enemy tempted Yahshua, He answered out loud from Deuteronomy (8:3, 6:16, 6:13). He fought with Torah. Isaiah saw the Servant's mouth made like a sharp sword (Isaiah 49:2).
The sword only works in your hand, not on the shelf. Read it. Hide it in your heart so it is there when you need it (Psalm 119:11). Then speak it when the attack comes.

Know it in context. The enemy quoted Psalm 91 too, and twisted it (Matthew 4:6). And let the word cut you first. It is sharper than any two-edged sword and judges the thoughts of the heart (Hebrews 4:12).
Yahshua, You are the Word. Put Your word in my heart and in my mouth.
Give me hunger to read it, discipline to remember it, and boldness to speak it.
Cut away what is wrong in me first.
When the enemy comes today, I will answer the way You did: it is written.
In Your name I speak Your word over my mind, my home, and my family. Amen.

The soldier Paul saw: Paul's word for sword, machaira, is a shorter blade for close fighting, like the Roman gladius. A later Roman writer, Vegetius, described recruits training with practice weapons heavier than real ones, so the real sword felt light in battle.
The word behind it: Paul chose rhema, which usually means a spoken word. It is the same word Yahshua used in Matthew 4:4, every word that proceeds out of Elohim's mouth.
Pick the biggest battle you are facing. Find one verse that speaks to it, memorize it, and say it out loud every time that battle shows up.

days.title: Day 7
days.subtitle: Praying at All Times
days.lede: ...praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful. (Ephesians 6:18)
days.note: WEB, divine name rendered YHWH, Elohim, and Adonai
days.shareText:
...praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful.
Ephesians 6:18

Prayer is not a seventh piece of armor. It is how you put on the other six.

https://app.kingdom-life-ministry.com
days.step: Choose one person to hold up in prayer every day this week. Then start each morning by praying through the full armor, piece by piece.

blocks.v: with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints:

When Amalek attacked, Joshua fought in the valley while Moses held up his hands on the hill. When his hands dropped, Amalek prevailed, so Aaron and Hur held them up until sunset (Exodus 17:8-13). The fight in the valley and the prayer on the hill were one battle.
Prayer is not a seventh piece of armor. It is how you put on the other six and stay in contact with your Commander. It is relationship, not ritual.
Paul, in chains, did not ask for release. He asked for boldness (Ephesians 6:19-20). Someone you know is in the valley right now. Be the one who holds up their hands.
Yahshua, I come to You as my Commander. Today I put on Your whole armor.
I buckle on Your truth.
I put on Your righteousness over my heart.
I stand in Your peace, ready to go where You send me.
I lift the shield of faith against every fiery dart.
I cover my mind with Your salvation.
I take up Your word as my sword.
Keep me awake and watchful. Teach me to pray at all times, not only in crisis.
Show me who to hold up in prayer today, and give me boldness to speak Your good news. Amen.
The soldier Paul saw: a Roman camp kept watch through the night in shifts, and Polybius describes harsh punishment for a sentry who failed his watch. Armor did a sleeping soldier no good.

The word behind it: Paul's word for being watchful, agrypneo, literally means to stay awake. The word for requests, deesis, means specific needs brought before Elohim. Alert, specific, and it keeps going.
Choose one person to hold up in prayer every day this week. Then start each morning by praying through the full armor, piece by piece.
